channel.title: The Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (occrp.org)

item.title: Slain Iranian Official’s Sons Hold $29M in Dubai Property Using Assumed Names
item.description: Hossein Shamkhani is sanctioned for allegedly running a shipping empire that generated billions of dollars for Iran and Russia. OCCRP has found that he and his brother own Dubai real estate under aliases in Caribbean passports.

item.title: Profiting From Atrocities: The Russian Civilians Running a Lucrative Market for War Snuff
item.description: A new investigation reveals how ordinary citizens hundreds of miles from the trenches are monetizing graphic videos from Ukraine through advertising and crowdfunding.

item.title: Phantom Contracts and Kickbacks: Poland's Judicial Corruption Scandal Widens
item.description: The latest arrests target insiders who allegedly used fake IT services to funnel state money into an organized criminal group operating right inside the justice system.

item.title: Alleged South American Kingpin Denied Bail After Extradition to U.S.
item.description: Sebastián Marset stands accused of using U.S. and European banks to launder millions in proceeds from his organization, which allegedly trafficked cocaine from South America to Europe

item.title: Report: Turkey Shuts Public Out of Trial for Erdogan’s Chief Rival
item.description: Report: Turkey Shuts Public Out of Trial for Erdogan’s Chief Rival

item.title: Kyrgyzstan Releases Prominent Investigative Journalist Pending Retrial
item.description: A Kyrgyz court freed a prominent investigative journalist after 18 months behind bars, placing her under a travel ban as she awaits a retrial in a case widely condemned as an attack on free speech.

item.title: Poisoned Trekkers and Phantom Flights: Nepal Charges 32 in Massive Himalayan Rescue Scam
item.description: A sprawling criminal network of trekking agencies, hospitals, and helicopter pilots allegedly fed tourists baking soda to induce illness, siphoning nearly $20 million in fraudulent insurance payouts.

item.title: Romanian Tycoon Linked to Sanctioned Belarusian Elites and Russian Drone Makers
item.description: Vitalie Buzdugan’s lucrative ventures in a Belarusian special economic zone heavily intersect with President Alexander Lukashenko’s inner circle, according to a new report.

item.title: Six Stand Trial in France as Marseille’s Deadly Drug War Enters the Courtroom
item.description: Leaders of the DZ Mafia, a Marseille-based criminal organization, face charges for a 2019 drug related double homicide - part of a surge in such homicides in France.

item.title: Inside the Supply Chain Funneling Irish Alumina to Russian Rockets
item.description: Leaked transaction data reveals how a major refinery in Ireland feeds into the aluminum supply chain of Russian weapons manufacturers arming Putin’s forces as they attack Ukraine.
